subject: Finalizing Architect Track & Local Reminder Cadence for 'Serving at Scale' Webinar
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mills <alex@acme.ai>, partners+events@cloudforge.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Finalizing Architect Track & Local Reminder Cadence for 'Serving at Scale' Webinar

Hi Alex + CloudForge team —

Thanks again for co-hosting the Architect track next month. Attached is the current agenda (ArchitectTrack_Agenda_v2.pdf) and a draft of the reminder cadence sheet (Local-Reminder-Cadence.xlsx). Two things I want to lock today so we can push registrations live Monday:

1) Localized reminder windows: we propose three regional reminder waves (NA/EU/APAC) tied to local business hours and a final 1-hour before push for local timezone attendees. The sheet outlines send windows, subject-line variants, and snooze rules.

2) RSVP link mapping and tracking: we need a single canonical registration link per region that includes partner-specific UTM + HubSpot campaign id so we can split out Acme registration credit. Example: https://redwoodhq.app/events/serving-at-scale/register?utm_source=acme&utm_region=na&utm_campaign=architect_seq1

Open questions for you: can Acme share a 1–2 sentence cohost blurb we can insert in the NA invite? Also confirm whether your field reps want a separate reminder for customers in their accounts (we can do rep-level RSVP slices).

Quick ask for internal folks: Ben — can you confirm tracking link naming conventions match the spreadsheet (we call them TRACK-REG-NA / TRACK-REG-EU / TRACK-REG-APAC)? Karthik — can you validate the final send windows will not conflict with other priority sends next week?

Thanks — aiming to freeze copy by EOD Friday so ops can build the journeys.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: ArchitectTrack_Agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB); Local-Reminder-Cadence.xlsx (XLSX, 52KB)
From: Alex Mills <alex@acme.ai>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing Architect Track & Local Reminder Cadence for 'Serving at Scale' Webinar

Irene —

This looks great, thanks. Quick answers:
- Blurb: “Join Acme AI to see how model sharding and KV-cache tuning deliver predictable p99 latency at scale.” Use that in the NA invite.
- Field reps: yes, we want rep-level reminders for named accounts. We’ll provide a list of 23 priority accounts by EOD Monday.

One ask on the tracking side: can we append partner_id=acme123 to the UTM so our CRM automatically attributes leads? If you can add that to TRACK-REG-NA we’ll be all set.

Also, small copy tweak request — for the 1-hour before reminder, can the subject be “Starting in 1 hour: Serving at Scale — Architect Track” for better urgency?

Alex
Alex Mills
Head of Integrations, Acme AI

Irene / Karthik —

Reviewed the cadence sheet and the proposed tracking names. A few operational notes:

- Naming conventions
  * TRACK-REG-NA -> redwood.track.reg.na.acme123 (we should standardize to dot-delimited for downstream parsing)
  * TRACK-REG-EU -> redwood.track.reg.eu.acme123
  * TRACK-REG-APAC -> redwood.track.reg.apac.acme123

- HubSpot: We’ll create three campaigns (architect_na_202612, architect_eu_202612, architect_apac_202612) and map the above tags to the source field. Karthik, I left a comment in the cadence sheet asking about send throttling during the NA evening window — if we throttle too much the final 1-hour push will miss some recipients.

- Rep-level slices: we can do them, but we need the account list and the rep email mappings by Tuesday EOD to include personalization tokens in the journey.

Irene: I also dropped a short pre-send checklist into the sheet (column: ops_ready). Please review and mark rows green as you confirm copy.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Growth Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: Local-Reminder-Cadence.xlsx (see comments)
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Thanks all — quick summary and action items (finalized cadence + ops-ready checklist):

- Copy freeze: EOD Tuesday, Nov 24. Ben will update tracking names to dot-delimited and create HubSpot campaigns. (Ben: please confirm campaign ids when done.)
- Acme blurb: confirmed (Alex) — added to NA invite. Partner_id=acme123 will be appended to UTM strings.
- Rep-level reminders: Alex to share 23 priority accounts by EOD Monday (we have Tuesday buffer for ops). We’ll map rep_email token during journey build.
- Send windows: Karthik to advise on throttling risk by Tuesday morning — if we need to shift the NA evening wave we’ll move it 60 minutes earlier.
- Final 1-hour subject line: Irene to use Alex suggestion for urgency.

I uploaded an updated cadence matrix with Ben’s naming updates and my notes: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LocalReminderMatrix (sheet: Ops_Ready). Ben/Karthik — please mark ops_ready=TRUE when complete.

If nothing else blocks, ops will schedule the first batch build for Wed AM and we’ll go live Monday for registration.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turn here.

— Irene
